steps.name: Given the PayPal sandbox API base URL is configured
Given the performance safety limits are loaded
Given a valid PayPal access token has been obtained
Given an order request for 1 "T-Shirt" item priced at "100.00" "USD" with intent "AUTHORIZE"
Given a load profile of 10 requests with 2 concurrent users at no more than 1 requests per second
When I run the load profile against the create order endpoint
Then every request in the load run should have succeeded
Then no request in the load run should have been rate limited
Then the observed request rate should not have exceeded the load profile limit
Then the average response time should be below 2000 milliseconds
Then the 95th percentile response time should be below 3000 milliseconds
